thread.title: Don't Miss Pinduoduo's Big Run - Pinduoduo (NASDAQ:PDD)

author: Snowball Investing
title: Don't Miss Pinduoduo's Big Run - Pinduoduo (NASDAQ:PDD)
text:
Pinduoduo I believe that Pinduoduo ( PDD ) has been misunderstood by the market for the following reasons: (1) People are likely to mislabel Pinduoduo as the "Groupon of China". Groupon's (NASDAQ: GRPN ) lackluster public market performance could potentially have a negative impact on Pinduoduo. (2) An investor may underestimate the power of Tencent's ( OTCPK:TCEHY ) WeChat ecosystem. (3) People may also worry too much about the counterfeit issues on Pinduoduo's platform. (4) Despite having 385.5 million active buyers as of Q3 2018, Pinduoduo is still a young company with less than four years of history.
People's misunderstanding of WeChat's ecosystem is demonstrated by the big surprise of Apple's ( AAPL ) recent earnings revision. Apple CEO Tim Cook blamed the entire $9B revenue gap between current and previous guidance to weaker-than-expected sales in Greater China. Notwithstanding the Trade War impact, the fundamental reason that caused Apple's earnings shortfall is that iPhone users in China are not as sticky as those in other markets. On the contrary, Tencent's WeChat ecosystem is a much more powerful ecosystem in China. iPhone's retention rate is 86% in the rest of the world vs. 50% in China. Pinduoduo can be easily accessed via the mini-program in WeChat that people do not have to download the Pinduoduo app. Secondly, it is true that there may exist legal and regulatory risks towards the counterfeit products on Pinduoduo's platform, nonetheless, Alibaba ( BABA ) went through a similar journey a couple of years ago. An investor would have missed the complete big run of Alibaba if he or she had been worried too much about the counterfeit issues. I believe the factors laid out above explain why investors might have underestimated the long-term value of Pinduoduo.
User Growth & Annual Spending Pinduoduo is the largest social e-commerce platform in China. Pinduoduo shoppers are able to instantly share product information with their friends through WeChat. These shoppers will enjoy a group discount if their friends make a purchase on Pinduoduo. It is highly likely that investors underestimate Pinduoduo's potential to quickly grow new users and to increase customer annual spending on its platform. Tencent's WeChat has more than 1 billion users and Alibaba has 580 million users, and hence, there are more than 400 million people in China who currently use WeChat but have not shopped on Alibaba's Taobao/Tmall platforms yet. Pinduoduo has an advantage to compete for the remaining e-commerce shoppers compared to Alibaba. Tencent is an important strategic shareholder of Pinduoduo, owning 18.5% of the company. By leveraging WeChat's traffic, Pinduoduo is able to acquire new users at a much lower cost compared to Alibaba and JD .
Source: Company Financials
As analyzed in my initial Pinduoduo coverage " What You Don't Know About Pinduoduo ", most of Pinduoduo's users come from third- or fourth-tier cities. Pinduoduo's user profile is better matched with the remaining potential online shoppers in China. Based on Aurora Mobile's ( JG ) most recent report on China's e-commerce market, Pinduoduo was able to grow its app penetration rate by 69% YoY, surpassing JD to become the second most installed e-commerce apps in China. Its MAU also bypassed JD and reached 286 million in November 2018, growing 205% YoY.
Source: Aurora Mobile's most recent Chinese E-commerce report
According to the Pinduoduo's Q3 earnings report, the annual spend per active user reached 894 RMB, growing 99% over Q3 2017, though it is still only a fraction of Alibaba's annual spend per user.
Source: Company Financials
Valuation I believe that Pinduoduo's $24B valuation is an attractive entry point. I assume Pinduoduo's active buyers' growth is going to reach a steady rate in the next two quarters and will grow at 2% QoQ until 2020, which adds another 100 million users in the next two years. I also assume that the average annual spend will grow at a declining rate and will double by 2020.
Source: Company Financials
I assume 3.4% take rate by the end of 2020 which is quite conservative compared to BABA's 4% in Q3 2018, 35% net margin vs. 50%+ for BABA's core e-commerce business and a 20x PE multiple. Investing at today's $24B market cap will generate 1.5x MOIC over two years. The biggest uncertainty of my projection is Pinduoduo's net profit margin. As Pinduoduo is still in the early expansion stage, the management team might want to keep sales & marketing expense high for a few years to acquire more users.
New Gaming Feature Duo Duo Orchard program is going to increase user stickiness and attract new users. In April 2018, Pinduoduo launched a new gaming feature called "Duo Duo Orchard" in its app. This new feature offers Pinduoduo users to grow a virtual tree for free. People receive a bonus as a form of "waterdrop" every time they log in the app or shop in the app. Pinduoduo users can also interact with their friends in this game. Pinduoduo users will receive actual fruits delivered to their homes if their trees begin to bear fruit. In June 2018 or just two months since the app launched, two million orchard trees were grown every day. More than 500 tons of fruits were delivered to Pinduoduo users. All the farmers in impoverished areas like Xinjiang Province benefited a lot from this program. In addition to significantly improving user stickiness and retention rate of existing users, this new feature is an effective advertisement tool compared to typical subsidies as it is directly targeted at the farmer community. These farmers who have benefited from this program are more likely to use the money earned from this program to shop on Pinduoduo platform, and more importantly, they may also tell their friends and family to shop on Pinduoduo. This feature allows Pinduoduo to improve the retention rate of the existing user and generate a good reputation among potential users. Two birds in one stone!
The competitive landscape of China's e-commerce market Most investors are worried about the counterfeit products on Pinduoduo. It is exactly the same critique when Alibaba went public in 2014. Alibaba founder Jack Ma used to joke about the only reason he did not crash JD is that Alibaba doesn't want to monopolize the market. His claim is probably exaggerated but he is not completely wrong. The Chinese government may not want to see one private sector player monopolize the entire e-commerce market in China.
Lots of investors prefer JD because of its authentic products and fast delivery. However, it is hard to keep its authentic brand image after an increasing number of 3P products are introduced. Its fast delivery moat will continue to decline as the fulfillment capability of parcel delivery industry in China continues to improve. People hope the gross margin of JD will improve as the company is going to gradually shift from 3Cs to other high margin categories such as apparel. In order to win the apparel category, JD needs to win over female consumers as 66% of the shoppers on JD are males. JD's CEO just got off the hooks on rape allegation. But how do you win over female customers if the CEO is surrounded himself with sex scandals? I believe Pinduoduo is going to continue to gain market share from JD and eventually compete with Alibaba head to head.
Source: Questmobile 2018.03
Conclusion I think Pinduoduo is misunderstood by the market because it is a young company and there is no comparable model in the U.S. Investors seem to underestimate the power of WeChat's ecosystem. Investors will likely be surprised by the upside. I think owning Pinduoduo at $24B valuation offers a very attractive risk-reward in the long term.
